claims.detail: Committed exemplar: average CPU under fifteen percent while SKUs remain pegged to holiday peak sizing.

findings.description: Right-sizing reviews show sustained low utilization on burstable VMs that could move to smaller SKUs or scheduled scale-in.
findings.recommendation: Attach FinOps dashboards and chargeback tags before the next reservation purchase window.

findings.description: Autoscale profiles exist for batch workers but batch queues drain slowly overnight leaving idle capacity.
findings.recommendation: Tighten scale-down cool-downs after validating maximum queue age SLOs.
